Middle East Tensions Impact Global Markets, Fueling Oil and Gold Price Volatility

Renewed military actions in the Middle East have led to increased volatility in global markets. Gold and silver prices have fallen, with gold reaching an intraday low of $3,977 and silver hitting $55.65, as Middle East tensions fuel fears of higher US interest rates. Simultaneously, oil prices have surged, impacting inflation concerns and leading to flight cancellations in the Gulf region. Asian gas prices have risen to their highest since March, and Pakistan announced it will revise petrol and diesel prices daily due to oil market volatility. Ukraine also reported hitting Russian oil and gas tankers in the Black Sea.
